I’m an outdoorsman, a hunter, and a gun owner. I am completely against removing the roadless rule. It will degrade and destroy the quality of the outdoors and the hunting all over the country.

I recreate in the Manti-lasal national forest. I participated both in off roading and recreation in roadless areas. I would prefer see less roads opened up to the public. I find excessive use of off road trails very damaging to the wilderness. With the ever growing amount of side by sides and off road vehicles, I think it would be very damaging to allow...

Sitting in Church yesterday, I ask myself “what part of this revision would help energy independence?” Answer- not one but of it does dismantle our public lands, setting them up for more expensive wildfires and sell off to private companies that benefit no American, unless youre the one who has direct involvement with mining companies. Hmmm.
This is a bad idea that will lead to destruction of habitats, more wildfires, increased search & rescues, & will advance climate crisis. Our public lands belong to all of us & we don’t want this!

The current travel management plan works well. My concerns include opening up large swaths of forest lands to vehicles that will move more people throughout the parcels displacing wildlife and limiting areas folks can hike into and get away from the crowds. There is a large potential for illegal off road use to expand destroying valuable habitat. I'm...
I urge you not to change the current approach to management of the national forest system lands.

I am begging that you please open up these closed forestry roads. I live in Hattiesburg MS and Camp Shelby and DeSoto National Forest have so many closed roads. Why did we spend the money to put up gates and rock these roads and yet the citizens cant even use them. You do not understand the hardship it causes to the outdoorsman
The more the better!
I’ve been riding in the woods for 50 years and this is the way.
Please don’t make any changes to the travel management
Don’t ruin what we have for some oil! We will need this later!!!!
